text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Run every hour

jobs:
  claudie-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-edit
          npm install -g yarn
          yarn install

      - name: Configure Claude
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}" >> ~/.bashrc
          source ~/.bashrc

      - name: Run Claude review
        run: |
          cd .cursor/commands
          ./review-pr.sh
```

Note: The `review-pr.sh` script should be created in the `.cursor/commands` directory and contain the logic to interact with Claude API based on the provided prompt. This script is not included in the provided YAML file.
